rule: Research rung F - published-verdict direction. Used only for an open fixture that reached rung D (no eligible outside price and no own line). A direction is published ONLY when HLTV's own match page and analytics summary state a one-sided verdict: every 'in favour of' line belongs to one team, every 'against' line belongs to the other, and the head-to-head record published on the same page points the same way. No percentage is produced: the probability columns stay blank, because no bookmaker price, prediction-market price or rating pair supports a number.
why_not_a_percentage: For both fixtures below the opponent is unranked on HLTV and has no row in Valve's official Regional Standings, so the own-line model has no input for it. Inventing a rating for an unranked team would be an inferred value, not a sourced one.
